experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Internship experiences spanning backend and mobile development, business analysis, database design, and enterprise IT workflows.

adm.description: Worked on business analysis, database design, web prototyping, and enterprise IT processes within the Digital Business Applications unit. Designed and built a PostgreSQL database for IT inventory and asset assignment, completed a customer request management case study with a React prototype, and gained hands-on exposure to enterprise workflows involving SAP, Jira, Solution Manager, Qlik, SCADA, and OSOS. References available on request.

inventory.title: IT Inventory, Stock and Asset Assignment System
inventory.desc: Designed and built a complete PostgreSQL database for IT inventory, warehouse stock, and employee asset assignment: 8 tables, 4 enum types, indexes, more than 10 triggers that enforce business rules, and 10 functions for stock entry, assignment, return, transfer, and status changes. Individual devices are tracked by serial number and bulk items by quantity. An immutable movement history records every event with its date and database user, and a view flags critical stock levels. Prepared sample-data scenarios and an ER diagram, and revised the design after review by a senior database specialist.

crm.title: Customer Request Management System Case Study
crm.desc: Completed an internal case study for a screen that manages customer requests from several channels in one place. Wrote the scope document: goals, in-scope and out-of-scope functions, user roles, assumptions and dependencies, and the approval process. Added functional requirements and wireframes for the request list, detail, and new request screens. Proposed the architecture and technology stack, designed a seven-table PostgreSQL data model with DDL, and built a working React + TypeScript + Vite prototype with Tailwind CSS on mock data.

enterprise.title: Enterprise IT and SAP Processes
enterprise.desc: Observed enterprise IT workflows including SAP ERP and ABAP development workflow, DEV to TEST to PROD transport process, and tooling around Jira, Solution Manager, and Qlik. Gained exposure to information security, KVKK, SCADA, and OSOS operations.

massguard.title: MASSGuard AI / Watt If? Ideathon
massguard.desc: Concept proposal analyzing MASS smart meter time-series data to produce risk scores and field inspection priorities for electricity theft and bypass anomalies, unregistered solar generation, and unusual consumption patterns. Designed as a decision-support concept, not an autonomous decision system.

flap.company: FLAP Yazılım / Teknolya Bilgi Teknolojileri A.Ş.
flap.description: Built a SQL Server backup management platform and an offline-first mail client, and made a small contribution to a company web app. Work covered backend services, databases, CI, and React and Flutter clients. References available on request.

backup.title: Backup Platform for Microsoft SQL Server
backup.desc: Built a centralized backup platform: an ASP.NET Core multi-tenant backend with Quartz.NET scheduling and PostgreSQL state, a Windows and Linux agent that polls for work, replica storage to local, central, SFTP, or Google Drive targets, and a React interface for jobs, runs, and restores. Set up CI and Docker packaging.

kaydetmail.title: Kaydetmail Mail Client
kaydetmail.desc: Built an offline-first, multi-account IMAP/SMTP mail client: a .NET 10 and PostgreSQL backend with incremental sync, server-first mutations, idempotent sends and push notifications, and a Flutter app with local cache, search, labels, snooze, and queued offline actions.

emutabakat.title: E-Mutabakat Web App (small contribution)
emutabakat.desc: Contributed to the company's account reconciliation web app with backend fixes for tenant boundaries, transactions and logging, configuration cleanup, and an accessible, high-contrast UI refresh.
